info.title: Nexus Dashboard API
info.description:
OpenAPI definition generated from the mounted Express routes in the uploaded `nexus-dashboard-full-pdf-layout-fixed` backend.

**Authentication:** Call `POST /api/auth/login`, copy the returned JWT token, then use the Swagger **Authorize** button. Enter only the token; Swagger adds `Bearer` automatically.

**Uploads:** Inquiry create/update/status APIs accept either JSON or multipart form data. For multipart requests, put the JSON payload in `_json` and upload files using the documented fields.

**Local server:** Start the backend on port 5000 before using Try it out.
